mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% in a single month signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as recession fears accelerate portfolio rebalancing.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 8.5% in a month but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1% monthly declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as earnings revisions accelerate downward.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 1%, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95 with rising housing starts signals supply chain dislocation offsetting housing strength, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as margin pressures intensify.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95 and HOUST > 480, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% monthly indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as earnings expectations rise sustainably.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase above 0.3% and non-farm payrolls decline exceeding 0.5% signal accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as recession risks escalate.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5%, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 480 thousand units while industrial production falls below 95 indicates conflicting supply signals, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as sectoral imbalances pressure earnings.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 480 and INDPRO < 95, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
